text:
Every afternoon she walked

with her mother along the Landstrasse


And on the corner

of the Schmiedtor

every afternoon


Hitler was there

waiting for her to see her pass


The taxis and buses

were full of kisses


And sweethearts rented boats

on the Danube.


But he did not know how

to dance. He never dared

to speak to you


Afterward she passed without her mother

with a cadet.


And afterward

she did not pass again.


From there later

the Gestapo

the annexation of Austria,


The world war.

translation.title: Every Afternoon She Walked
translation.editorial_note: The source says 'Australia,' but the historical sequence points to Austria; the translation follows that context.
